paper: QuTiP 2: A Python framework for the dynamics of open quantum systems
pilot_concept: Release qualification of a spectral-bath dynamics service
archetype: A: workspace diagnosis, repair, and performance validation
central_contribution: Arbitrary time-dependent open-system solvers, Bloch-Redfield and Floquet-Markov evolution, with process diagnostics and efficient comparative simulations.
central_claim: Microscopic spectral-bath dissipation can differ materially from local Lindblad approximations in driven and coupled systems.
decision: Conventional Redfield/Floquet generator construction, sparse or block Lindblad propagation, and ordinary amplitude/vectorization repairs solved every hidden family. The fresh agent completed independent checks, a real revision loop, resource studies and reproducible evidence. Reject rather than add edge cases or tighter thresholds.
